about: CCC 26.9 tenants are hot-patched to serve PATCH /api/identity-graph/v1/devices/{id} (ENG-31142 server fix, Elisity/ccc PR #17262). The published 26.9 spec predates the hot patch and declares only PUT and DELETE at that path. The CLI omits the device PUT (ENG-31333), so `devices update-device` exists only if this overlay is applied: python3 generate_commands.py --spec <26.9 spec> --overlay spec-overlays/ccc-26.9-hotpatch-device-patch.json. Remove this file once the published spec declares the PATCH; until then the generator prefers the spec's own definition if it ever has one.

set.description: Same permission, target-enrichment-layer query parameter and If-Match precondition as PUT. An omitted, null or empty ip or venId keeps the device's current value, so an attribute-only update does not detach the device. Attributes are merged into the target enrichment layer. Returns 204 with no body.
